name: National Data Centre (NDC) - Juba
developer: Government of South Sudan (MICT&PS); MGI Communications AG technical support via NCA Gateway Services and Data Center Oversight Committee
notes: Only countable government DC seed in South Sudan, located in Juba (Central Equatoria). Minister Ateny Wek Ateny at 15th Connected Africa Summit (Eye Radio, 30 Apr 2026): construction ongoing and 'now halfway complete'. NCA established Gateway Services and Data Center Oversight Committee with MGI Communications AG (Eye Radio 17 Jan 2026; TechAfrica News 20 Jan 2026). Capacity, address, operator/contractor and timeline not public. B-grade (press quoting officials) until an official MICT&PS/NCA page, procurement/tender or commissioning record appears; World Bank Jun 2022 diagnostic baseline found no fully functional carrier-neutral DC and no IXP.

name: South Sudan International Gateway (SSIGW)
developer: SSIGW operator; MGI Communications AG (management and technical support)
notes: International voice/SMS gateway facility in Juba, operational since ~2014 (existence is A-grade via World Bank 2022 diagnostic; 2026 committee reporting is B-grade press). NOT a datacenter - gateway facility listed separately per methodology. Jan 2026 NCA committee targets gateway-services control, revenue digitisation and national data-centre oversight.
